children: Enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise
will be reporting results this Monday after the bell. Here’s what to look for.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise beat analysts’ revenue expectations last quarter, reporting revenues of $12.21 billion, up 33.7% year on year. It was an impressive quarter for the company, with a beat of analysts’ EPS estimates and a solid beat of analysts’ EPS guidance for next quarter estimates.
Is Hewlett Packard Enterprise a buy or sell going into earnings?

params.linkText: Read our full analysis here, it’s free for active Edge members

children: This quarter, the market is expecting Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s revenue to grow 49.3% year on year, improving from the 14.4% increase it recorded in the same quarter last year.

Analysts covering the company have generally reconfirmed their estimates over the last 30 days, suggesting they anticipate the business will stay the course heading into earnings. Hewlett Packard Enterprise has missed Wall Street’s revenue estimates multiple times over the last two years.

Looking at Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s peers in the hardware & infrastructure segment, some have already reported their Q3 results, giving us a hint as to what we can expect. Super Micro delivered year-on-year revenue growth of 298%, beating analysts’ expectations by 18.6%, and IonQ reported revenues up 336%, topping estimates by 37%. Super Micro traded down 5.7% following the results while IonQ was up 23.4%.

In the last year or so, investors have shifted their focus from one macro dynamic to the next (AI disintermediation and AI investment to geopolitical conflict, interest rates, and the health of the wider economy). While some of the hardware & infrastructure stocks have shown solid performance in this choppy environment, the group has generally underperformed, with share prices down 9.5% on average over the last month. Hewlett Packard Enterprise is down 26.1% during the same time and is heading into earnings with an average analyst price target of $70.58 (compared to the current share price of $41.90).
